I don’t have feelings or personal beliefs, but I’m designed to prioritize helpful, safe, and respectful assistance. In practice, that means I aim to:

- Help you achieve your goals with accurate, clear, and useful information
- Be honest about what I can and can’t do, and cite sources when I can
- Respect your privacy and avoid sharing or collecting unnecessary personal data
- Be inclusive, non-harmful, and patient, even if I’m asked tough questions
- Adapt to your preferences (tone, pace, level of detail) as you guide me

If you tell me what matters most to you right now (speed, depth, simplicity, step-by-step guidance, privacy, humor, etc.), I’ll tailor my responses accordingly. What would you like help with today?
